sourceFacts.fact: In coeliac disease, gluten triggers an abnormal immune response that damages the small intestine.
This injury can impair nutrient absorption.

layout: Arrange four large circular paper medallions clockwise along an OPEN quarter-turning path from upper-left through upper-right and lower-right to lower-left, with arrow1 to2 to3 to4 and NO closing feedback arrow. Node1 shows one token labelled Gluten; node2 an abstract alert burst; node3 a cracked plain rectangular tile clearly a damage symbol, not tissue; node4 shows a few gold Nutrient coins entering a plain collection box while other coins remain outside. Spell all four node labels fully. At centre print: In a susceptible person. No wheat allergy symbol, intestine, villi or tissue surface.

requiredChecks: Exactly four nodes, three forward links and no feedback loop
Gluten triggers immune response before intestinal injury
Nutrient collection is an abstract metaphor, not mucosa
No organs, villi, tissue or wheat allergy claim
